جَامُورٌ : see جُمَّارٌ. ―
-b2- Also (tropical:) A well-known appertenance of a ship or boat; [i. e., the head of the mast; a kind of truck, which is made of harder wood than the mast itself.] (TA.) ―
-b3- And hence, (tropical:) The head [absolutely]: but accord. to Kr, only the vulgar call it so. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
